title: CSS Grid Layouts
description: Learn how to use CSS Grid to create two-dimensional layouts that offer powerful control over rows and columns.

lessons.title: Introduction to CSS Grid
lessons.content: CSS Grid Layout is a two-dimensional layout system for the web, allowing control over rows and columns simultaneously.

lessons.title: Placing Items with grid-column and grid-row
Implicit vs Explicit Grids
lessons.content: Explicit grids are defined with template rows/columns, while implicit grids are auto-generated by placing items outside defined boundaries.

lessons.title: Mini Project: Responsive Grid Portfolio Layout
lessons.content: /* Build a responsive image or project portfolio using CSS Grid with named areas and auto-fit columns */
